newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Eng wins $150 mln Thai order.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Eng wins $150 mln Thai order.

text.p: Samsung Engineering Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Wednesday it has won a $150 million order to build a petrochemical plant in Thailand on a turn-key basis.

Samsung said in a statement the plant, to be built in the south-eastern Rayong industrial complex, would be equipped to annually produce 140,000 tonnes of butadiene, 40,000 tonnes of butadiene rubber and 60,000 tonnes of styrene butadiene rubber.
Construction is due to be completed in November, 1998.
